Q: Is Capitalism Broken?
A: Not yet, but it could be. It was never designed by anybody. It just grew and evolved in response to financial and political pressures. It spread around the world because of the economic power of those who used it. There are as many different possible versions of capitalism as there are creative minds to dream them up. It seems very unlikely that our present system is the best we could possibly invent. Let's keep dreaming up a better version. It's not broken yet, but it does need to be broken and replaced if we are to build the next version. We could do better.
